decisions.reason: The dismantling joint sits close to the firm's established pipeline-fittings offer, so it took little extra investment and is cheap to keep in a catalogue that customers expect to be complete, and one year is too short to judge its results.

The firm has visibly committed to the pipe bracket with its own web page as part of its announced range expansion, and since it was launched only recently, any weak sales can still be put down to temporary start-up causes.

The pipe support bracket has its own dedicated page and fits the publicly stated direction of broadening the range, so dropping it this early would write off the effort and contradict that commitment.
